method: Plate L=100, W=80, T=20 mm; Bore1 at (20,20) Ø10; Bore2 at (60,50) Ø10. Box minus independently located through-cylinders: V=LWT-sum(pi*d²*T/4), area=2(LW+LT+WT)+sum(pi*d*T-pi*d²/2), mass moments from exact box minus cylinders. Shape: four exterior vertical R10 corner rounds; full upper tangent loop 2 mm chamfer; four corner spandrels subtract volume T*(4-pi)*R² at symmetric centroid (L/2,W/2,T/2); rounded perimeter P=2(L+W)-8R+2pi*R; upper tangent chamfer subtracts volume Vc=P*c²/2-pi*c³/3 at (L/2,W/2,T-(P*c³/6-pi*c⁴/12)/Vc); area from upper inset face, side strips and sqrt(2)*c*(P-pi*c) bevel surface
